title: security: RBAC v2 - enforce KMS region pinning and improve audit logging
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 KMS region pinning behavior and make audit trails explicit for key selection decisions. Customers operating under data residency constraints reported ambiguous audit events when server-side KMS key selection fell back to default keys; this change enforces region residency constraints at policy evaluation time and surfaces deterministic audit events for every KMS decision.

What this PR does: - Add 'kms_region' constraint enforcement to RBAC v2 policy evaluation so requests that attempt cross-region key usage are denied at policy-check time (configurable enforcement mode: audit | enforce). - Emit structured audit events when a KMS key is selected, when a key is rejected due to region mismatch, and when policy falls back to tenant-default keys. Events include: request_id, principal, resource, requested_region, selected_key_arn, selection_reason, policy_match. - Extend policy schema with new optional fields: "kms_region_pin" and "kms_enforcement_mode" (values: "audit"|"enforce"). Backwards compatible: default behavior remains unchanged unless policy sets these fields. - Add unit and integration tests covering policy parsing, evaluation, and audit event emission for hostnames, VPC/private deployments, and the hosted API. - Update RBAC migration to backfill policy metadata for tenants with existing KMS configs (scripts are idempotent). - Docs and release notes explaining new policy keys and recommended migration steps.

Checklist: - [x] Policy schema changes + validation - [x] Enforcement logic in rbac-evaluator - [x] Audit event schema and log sink integration - [x] Unit tests and integration tests - [x] Migration script + dry-run safety checks - [x] Docs update (redwood-docs) - [x] Security review

Related: Linear ENG-4821, SEC-201; related PRs: #106789 (kms residency telemetry), #110987 (rbac v2 audit enhancements).

Maya Chen (author): Addressed nits and added snake_case mapping layer in emitters. Added integration test 'test_cross_region_reject' that runs against a local kms-mock.

Lena García (security): Requested explicit telemetry for when enforcement mode is changed from audit->enforce and asked for migration dry-run to log potential rejects. Confirmed threat model will be added to SEC review doc.
Ethan Brooks (approver): Verified CI and tests locally, requested one more e2e run on the Dedicated staging cluster before merge.
release_notes: Enforceable KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 policies and improved audit events for KMS key selection. Administrators can opt into enforcement via the new 'kms_enforcement_mode' policy field; default remains audit-only. Migration script available to backfill tenant KMS metadata. See docs/security/rbac-v2/kms-region-pinning.md for migration steps and telemetry details.
